## Checklist

- [ ] Prompt folder uses lowercase kebab-case (if adding a new prompt).
- [ ] Prompt follows the structure described in `CONTRIBUTING.md` (role, ordered workflow, section-by-section questions, rules, output format, "Begin now by..." line).
- [ ] `sample-interaction.txt` uses fictional names, places, costs, and details only.
- [ ] Root `README.md` "Prompts" list updated (if adding a new prompt).
- [ ] Root `README.md` "AI Tool Compatibility" table updated (if the prompt needs a different AI capability than existing prompts).
- [ ] No real club, partner, beneficiary, donor, or grant data included anywhere in this PR.
